subject: [PATCH 04/12] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: The reviewer suggested renaming some enum values in scan_result to better reflect their meaning and improve clarity, specifically SCAN_SCAN_ABORT, SCAN_ANY_PROCESS, and SCAN_COPY_MC.
reviews.raw_body:
Are you planning to clean up scan_result? SCAN_SCAN_ABORT sounds funny,
SCAN_ANY_PROCESS means nothing, SCAN_COPY_MC might better be
COLLAPSE_COPY_MC.

Anyway, for this patch,

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>



-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and state of the collapse mechanism from its implementation in khugepaged.c. The new header defines an enum for scan results and a struct for control data, as well as two constants that were previously defined in khugepaged.c. This separation is intended to clarify the distinction between users and implementers of the collapse interface.

These 2 macros are already self-explanatory, and the comments are

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author acknowledges that renaming the enum is a separate task and not part of this series, but has added it to their list.
reviews.raw_body:
I was not, but it is on my list now.  Not as part of this series: the
rename touches every result site and the tracepoint's EM() table, and
this patch only moves the enum.
